run_training_script: run the end-to-end negotiator training script with default RNN model on object division domain
train_with_custom_model_type: train the negotiator model using a custom model type and specified data corpus path
train_with_cuda: train the negotiator model on GPU using CUDA with configurable batch size and learning rate
train_with_clustering: train the negotiator model with clustering enabled and a specified number of clusters
save_trained_model: train and save the negotiator model to a specified file path with separate model components
